messages:
maria-l: thinking out loud — we should automate the scan lifecycle: when SAST/DAST finds a P0/P1, create a security ticket, attach minimal evidence, and kick off an escalation play. low noise, fast triage.

alex-k: +1. what's the minimal evidence we need? stack trace + file + git sha?

maria-l: minimal = file path, snippet (<=5 lines), PR number, pipeline job id, and a signed artifact link. keep payload small so webhook doesn't time out.

raj-p: can infra give the scanner a service identity to fetch artifacts from the artifact store? RBAC is current blocker — we don't want to widen perms across repos.

infra-bot: note: service account proposal required: role=scanner_fetcher, scope=project:artifacts:read, condition=repo in allowlist. audit logs enabled.

alex-k: that sounds OK. need to ensure KMS decrypt for evidence links is auditable. where would ephemeral keys live?

maria-l: plan: use customer-keystore-like workflow internally: scanner requests ephemeral token from KMS-service via signed CSR, KMS-service issues short-lived wrapping key to decrypt artifact metadata only. All requests logged.

devsec-bot: CI alert: nightly-scan job #482 failed with 3 critical sqli findings in service-x. https://ci/reports/482

sarah-c: stepping in — those are likely real. We should auto-open a ticket in SECURITY-QUEUE and assign to oncall if severity=critical and age>1h.

maria-l: propose escalation rules: severity=critical -> SECURITY-QUEUE -> 1st responder oncall -> 30min SLA; severity=high -> triage-team queue -> 12h SLA. Lower severities stay in premerge suppression flow.

raj-p: how about suppression / evidence retention? ops wants to keep suppressed evidence for 90 days for audits, security wants 180 days. cost impact?

alex-k: cost approximations: storing 180d of small snippets + links is cheap (<$200/mo) but full artifacts cost more. propose: store only metadata+signed artifact link + compressed snippet for 180d; full artifact for 30d unless escalated.

maria-l: agreed. put this in the playbook. sample webhook payload we discussed: 
```json
{
  "finding_id": "abc123",
  "severity": "critical",
  "file": "service-x/src/db/query.go:112",
  "snippet": "SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?",
  "pr": "https://gh/pr/1234",
  "artifact_link": "s3://scans/artifacts/abc123.enc",
  "artifact_key_wrap": "kms+wrappedKeyId",
  "pipeline_job": "nightly-scan-482"
}
```

sarah-c: nice. on RBAC: I'll draft a minimal role binding template and post in /eng-ops for review. include condition clauses and required audit annotations.

raj-p: for KMS audit logging, are we happy with logs hitting the security-central-project? must ensure log retention TTL covers compliance.

maria-l: yes, central logs with immutable retention of 365 days for high severity operations. lower-level logs 90 days. add a flag for legal_hold.

infra-bot: action created: IAM PR template at https://gh/pulls/iam/scan-fetcher-proposal. reviewers: @alex-k @sarah-c @maria-l.

alex-k: I'll review the IAM PR today. once approved, I'll wire up the webhook consumer in the triage-service.

devsec-bot: bump: adding DAST integration note — DAST finds should follow same lifecycle, but include runtime request logs and reproduction steps.

maria-l: yep. add reproduction step checklist: curl command, auth token used (ephemeral), and repro environment. store repro env for 30d.

sarah-c: final ask — add an incident escalation override if a suppressed finding later becomes exploitable in prod. we need auto-reopen rules.

maria-l: good call. will include an auto-reopen if (suppressed && exploitability_score>=7) or if prod error rate spikes near related service.

raj-p: thanks team. I'll follow up with a short RFC doc + timeline. aiming for a canary rollout next sprint. :rocket:
